[[Image:V1_Quarter_ZR-4K_dm3-1.jpg]]

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/f/fe/Zr-4k-dm3-hib.qwd hib (ZR)] | [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/0/04/Zr-4k-dm3-rock.qwd Rock (ZR)]

"Interesting match as 4K seemed to get the better start (I know they got pent) and racking up a few frags. ZR coming back strong boomsticking their way to better weapons and a tied game around the fourth minute. I think Acid got the next pent and used it to get quad. In any case the game swinged to ZR's favor and they were fragging pretty hard when Jaguar and Acid dissed. 4K gathered momentum and hunted the two remaining Finns around the level. Then Perza stepped in for ZR, helping out until the other two members could get back in. Zetor still did a great job not loosing out completely as they lost two of their guys. GG!. - Ego"
=== DM3-2 === ZR: 195 - 4K: 82
[[Image:V1_Quarter_ZR-4K_dm3-2.jpg]]

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/7/72/Zr-4k-dm3_2-rock.qwd Rock (ZR)]

"Second round. Again 4K gets the better start and takes an early lead. They proceed to play good, keeping head to head with the Finns. ZR looks slightly stronger though, as they are keeping up even though 4K seems to have better control of the level. I don't remember Acid dissing, but judging from the SS he did =). I do remember 4K^Janus giving up his post as the lag and pl got to bad (he almost dissed) and Rags scrambling in to take his position. ZR kept the pressure up and soon were in control. They didn't let go of the hold and took this map with a comfortable margin. - Ego"
